title: The Team Name Will Be... the Little Busters
overview: The leader of the "Little Busters," Kyousuke, returns to school after a job hunting break and calls the old gang together. He suggests that they all do something that they can only do now, while they're young - and that something is playing baseball. Now all Kyousuke, Riki, Masato, Kengo, and Rin need to do is find enough new members to make a complete baseball team...

title: If You're Happy, I'm Happy
overview: Riki meets the cheerful, easygoing Komari on a visit to the school rooftop, and decides to invite her to join the Little Busters. Meanwhile, one of the cats Rin is taking care of strolls along with a mysterious note tied to its tail...

title: I Like Cute Things, You See
overview: Riki is called out for tea and a chat by Kurugaya Yuiko, a mysterious girl who rarely shows up to class. He invites her to join the Little Busters, but when she meets the team's resident musclebrain, Masato, sparks instantly fly.

title: We'll Make a Happy, Sunny Place
overview: On the school roof, Riki catches Komari whispering something about an older brother in her sleep. But when she wakes up, she tells him that she's an only child and her brother only appears to her in dreams, where he reads her a sad story from a picture book only to fade away when she awakens...

title: To Find What I’ve Lost
overview: When Komari's normally cheerful smiles begin to look sad and lonely, Riki decides to cheer her up by searching for her older brother... but does he really exist? The next day, the two of them pay a visit to Komari's hometown in hopes of recovering her lost memories.

title: Let's Find Wonderful Things
overview: Komari has finally recovered her memories of her older brother - and it has left her in a tragic state of confusion. With the support of the Little Busters, Riki sets out to bring Komari's cheerful smile back.

title: Now Then, Guess Who!
overview: The Little Busters are still short a few members, so Riki decides to invite a girl from a neighboring class, Saigusa Haruka, to the team. But the energetic, playful Haruka has a reputation for being the school's biggest troublemaker, and is under constant pursuit by the school's Disciplinary Committee.

title: Let's Look for Roommate!
overview: When Riki sees Kud playing Frisbee with her dogs, he knows that her quick, agile movements would make her a good candidate for the Little Busters and extends the invitation. But Kud hasn't had an easy time making friends since she came to Japan, and she could use the help of her new teammates to find a willing dorm roommate.

title: Save the Cafeteria!
overview: One of Rin's cats brings her yet another mysterious note. This time its cryptic demand is to "save the school cafeteria" - but none of the Little Busters can see what about the cafeteria needs saving.

title: The Blue of the Sky, the Blue of the Sea
overview: While searching for a stray ball sent flying at a Little Busters practice, Riki encounters Mio, a girl who always sits and reads in the shade of a tree with a parasol open. There's one book she's particularly fond of, but she won't tell Riki what it's about. When she loses the book, it's up to Riki to help her find it.

title: See, There Ain't No Ghosts
overview: Kyousuke gathers the Little Busters together for a little test of courage. Their mission takes them on a search through the school building while avoiding traps set by Kyousuke, but eventually they sense that an eerie black shadow has been watching their progress...

title: A Blue World, Stretching on to Eternity
overview: Riki has invited Mio to be the manager of the Little Busters, and the team welcomes her warmly. However, just when they think she's finally opening up to them, she disappears...

title: Where the End Begins
overview: Mio has been absent from school for several days, and everyone, even the Little Busters, seems to be gradually forgetting about her. Riki finally spots her in the courtyard again, but he notices an unfamiliar loneliness in her eyes...

title: That’s Why I’ll Hold My Hand Out to You
overview: When was the last time anyone saw Mio reading a book under the tree in the courtyard? What kind of person was she? Riki's memories become vague and he becomes scared that he might forget her completely. Will he be able to find the real Mio before she completely disappears?

title: Hell Yeah, This Totally Rocks!
overview: Rin has called Riki to her room under false pretenses. Now he is stuck for the night while his friends mount a rescue attempt.

title: Don't Look at Me Like That
overview: Saigusa Haruka is considered the biggest rule violator at school and the school Disciplinary Committee has it out for her, in particular Futaki Kanata. When Haruka’s family history is posted over the school the Little Busters must search for her.

title: I Wanted Someone to Stay by My Side
overview: The secret of the Saigusa family is explained to the Little Buster crew, and Riki wants to help his friend cope with her new Infamy.

title: The Answer Is Within Your Heart
overview: With the encouragement of her friends, Haruka confronts Futaki and lays it all out. What  Futaki has to share will change how the Little Busters view her.

title: Keep Working Hard
overview: Kud might be smart be she lacks some common sense concepts due to her traveling. With the upcoming practical exams the Little Busters aim to help her ace the test.

title: Cure the Lovesick
overview: Sasasegawa Sasam and Rin continue to have battles, but that is pushed aside for as another one of her cats have brought her a mysterious message to help another student.

title: Fifty Nautical Miles into the Sky
overview: Kud shares an ancient island custom with Riki as she remembers the time she spent with her mother.

title: I Promise I’ll Come Back
overview: The Little Busters are there to help, but sometimes they are powerless to do anything.

title: For Those You Love
overview: Tebwa rebel forces are angry at the government and are looking for anyone connected  with the space program to blame…

title: If Rin-chan Is Happy, I’m Happy, Too
overview: Rin next challenge has been delivered and Riki has grown more suspicious of the timing of the notes.

title: The Final Member
overview: Kyousuke predictions of the final Little Buster member shocks Riki, but that is not the  bombshell that will be presented to Riki.

title: The Greatest of Friends
overview: Thrust into the role of leader of the Little Busters, Riki is finding it hard to fill Kyousuke shoes.
